group_delete_confirmation: Are you sure you want to delete this group?
update_policy_single_instance: Only update 1 instance at a time, and stop if an update fails.
track_identifier: Track (identifier for clients, filled with the group ID if omitted)
update_policy_no_rate_limit: Instances are not rate limited and can all update in the same period.
update_policy_no_rate_limit_safe_mode: No limit per period, but safe mode still updates 1 instance at a time.
max_updates_too_high: Must be less than {{number, number}}. For no limit, choose Unlimited.
default_policy_hint: This is the default policy of every node. A node that overrides a setting keeps its override.
default_policy_caption: Replicated to every node. Applies where a node has no override.
default_policy_caption_edge: Replicated from the control node. Read-only here.
default_policy_read_only: Read-only on an edge node. Change it on the control node.
this_node_caption: In effect on this node. Overrides are not replicated.
override_tooltip: Set on this node only, in place of the default.
pause_updates_confirmation: Pause updates on this node? They stay paused until resumed on this node, even if the default policy enables them.
resume_updates_confirmation: Resume updates on this node? Updates then follow the default policy again.
local_overrides_intro: Overrides apply to this node only and are not replicated. They can make this node stricter or looser than the default, such as by turning safe mode off. A setting that is not overridden follows the default.
no_groups_yet: There are no groups for this application yet.<1/><2/>Groups help you control how you want to distribute updates to a specific set of instances.
